summary: SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_NC_v1 draft artifacts pass all critical and major doctrine checks. Second exterior overhead field-surface spec — closely mirrors soffit spec with key simplifications: no vent type constraint (spray always eligible), no vinyl substrate path, beadboard panel type added. 31 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json (23 binary, 6 qt_scaled, 2 qt_conditional). All PaintScope keys use PS_EXT_* namespace. All substrate states use SS_EXT_* prefix. All protection zones use ext_* prefix. No interior keys, states, or zones present. Key porch-ceiling-specific features validated: spray tasks have no vent gating (correct — porches have no attic vents), beadboard correctly grouped with tg_board for joint complexity modifier (1.20x), overhead rates match soffit baselines, furniture protection zone added (porch-specific), ceiling fan masking rate appropriately slower than standard fixtures. Modifier stacking worst case 1.92x (T&G/beadboard + scaffold) is well under 4.0x cap (lower than soffit 2.208x because no vent complexity modifier). 5 material systems (3 primer + 2 finish, no vinyl-specific systems). 0 critical issues, 0 major issues, 2 minor observations.

issues.description: FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS assigns beadboard the same 1.20x modifier as tg_board. Beadboard may have slightly different groove geometry (narrower, more grooves per linear foot on narrow beadboard profiles). No field calibration data exists for beadboard-specific production rates.
issues.resolution: Acknowledged — 1.20x is a reasonable starting assumption since the painting technique (brush into grooves) is identical. Flag for field calibration. Beadboard width (3.5 vs 5.5 inch) may affect actual rate.

issues.description: TSK_PRCH_FIXTURE_MASK uses 8 EA/hr average rate for porch ceiling fixtures. This blends ceiling fans (~4-6 EA/hr, complex multi-blade masking) with recessed cans (~12-15 EA/hr, simple tape). If a porch has only ceiling fans or only recessed cans, the blended rate may be inaccurate.
issues.resolution: Acknowledged — blended rate is appropriate for estimation. Future enhancement could split into separate ceiling fan and recessed can masking tasks. Flag for field calibration.

doctrine_checks.details: All 31 task_ids in sop_modules.json have matching entries in production.json. No orphaned tasks. Count by module: SETUP=6, PREP=7, PRIME=4, FINISH_1=4, INTERSTAGE=4, FINISH_2=4, FINAL_INSPECT=2, CLEANUP=3. Note: fewer tasks than soffit (31 vs 37) because no vinyl substrate tasks (removed 4 vinyl-specific tasks) and no separate vent-gated spray tasks (spray always eligible, reducing duplicate task variants).

6 qt_scaled tasks (CUTIN_JUNCTIONS_1, CUTIN_JUNCTIONS_2, INSPECT_COAT, TOUCHUP_REPAIR, FINAL_INSPECT, FINAL_TOUCHUP) have qt_rates in production.json. 2 qt_conditional tasks (SAND_INTERCOAT, DUST_INTERCOAT) have appears_in_tiers [QT4]. 23 binary tasks use flat rate_per_hour or fixed_time_minutes.

Application method gating consistent: spray tasks gate on application_method [spray], brush_roll tasks gate on [brush_roll]. NO vent type gating — correct for porch ceiling (key difference from soffit). Substrate-specific tasks gate on substrate_material. Groove brush-back tasks gate on porch_ceiling_panel_type [tg_board, beadboard].

All task UOMs match. SF-based: 22 tasks. EA-based: 4 tasks (fixture mask, furniture protect, seal edges, spot prime knots). LF-based: 1 task (caulk). FIXED: 4 tasks (equipment setup brush/spray, clean equipment, site cleanup).
All 31 task IDs use TSK_PRCH_ prefix. No collisions with existing prefixes.
All 8 module IDs use MOD_PRCH_ prefix: SETUP, PREP, PRIME, FINISH_1, INTERSTAGE, FINISH_2, FINAL_INSPECT, CLEANUP.
All paintscope_key references use PS_EXT_* namespace. 8 PS keys declared. No interior keys.
All substrate states use SS_EXT_* prefix. 3 input states: SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD, SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY, SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD. 2 output states: SS_EXT_PAINTED_FLAT, SS_EXT_PAINTED_SATIN. No SS_INT_*.

5 protection zones use ext_* prefix: ext_porch_floor, ext_porch_furniture, ext_light_fixture, ext_fascia_adjacent, ext_wall_adjacent. All referenced in sop_modules.json (setup and teardown). No interior zones.
FAC_EXT_ACCESS declared with correct values (ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50). Applied to 23 overhead tasks. Ground-level tasks correctly excluded.

FAC_EXT_ACCESS reused from siblings. FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS declared (tg_board=1.20, beadboard=1.20, solid_panel=1.00). No FAC_SFIT_VENT_COMPLEXITY — correct removal (no vent concern on porch). FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD baked into rates.

All modifiers use division formula. Stacking cap 4.0x. 5 examples. Max combination: T&G/beadboard + scaffold = 1.20 x 1.60 = 1.92x (well under cap). Lower max than soffit (2.208x) because no vent complexity modifier. Math verified: 120 / 1.92 = 62.5 SF/hr.

Three substrate-driven primer paths: (1) acrylic for bare wood and factory-primed FC, (2) alkali-resistant for bare FC, (3) skip for field-primed. Tannin spot-prime for wood knots. 2 finish systems: standard (QT2/QT3), premium (QT4). 5 total material systems. No vinyl systems — correct exclusion.

Spray tasks do NOT gate on any vent type dimension. All spray tasks gate only on application_method: [spray]. No soffit_vent_type or porch_vent_type in applies_when. Correct — porch ceilings have no attic ventilation concern.
BAKED_INTO_BASE_RATES approach documented. FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD NOT applied as stacking modifier. Same design as soffit. Overhead reduction ratios documented.

TSK_PRCH_GROOVE_BRUSH_BACK_1 and TSK_PRCH_GROOVE_BRUSH_BACK_2 gate on spray + [tg_board, beadboard] (both panel types). Rates: 150 SF/hr. FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS NOT applied to these tasks (rate already reflects groove work). Beadboard correctly included in gate.
ext_porch_floor (primary drip zone), ext_porch_furniture (porch-specific — not in soffit), ext_wall_adjacent (house wall at porch attachment — not in soffit). Appropriate porch-specific zones added.
Only flat and satin allowed. COMPAT-PRCH-004 enforces restriction. All finish systems list allowed_sheens: [flat, satin].
5 zones declared with conditions, levels, and PS key mappings. All referenced in setup/teardown tasks.
4 round configurations: ROUND_PRCH_PRIME_2FINISH, ROUND_PRCH_PRIME_1FINISH, ROUND_PRCH_2FINISH, ROUND_PRCH_1FINISH. Covers all QT x substrate_state combinations.
setup -> prep -> prime -> finish -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup (final_inspect + cleanup). Correct ordering.

CON_ prefix (not CONS_), task_classification (not task_class), severity uses critical/major/minor, phase values from approved set, all units uppercase, consumable_category from approved set, zones use ext_* prefix.

key_departures_from_soffit_sibling: NO vent type gating — spray always eligible (no attic vent concern)
NO vinyl substrate — removed bonding primer and solar-reflective finish systems (5 systems vs 7)
Beadboard panel type added (grouped with tg_board for 1.20x modifier)
Porch-specific protection zones: ext_porch_floor, ext_porch_furniture, ext_wall_adjacent
Ceiling fan masking is more complex than standard fixtures (8 EA/hr vs 10 EA/hr soffit)
Lower max modifier stacking (1.92x vs 2.208x) — no vent complexity modifier
Fewer tasks (31 vs 37) — no vinyl tasks, no vent-gated duplicate spray tasks
Spray equipment setup slightly faster (45 min vs 50 min) — no vent verification
Adjacent surface set includes wall_field and porch_column (not in soffit)

modifier_stacking_validation.worst_case_scenario: T&G/beadboard board porch ceiling, scaffold access: FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS(1.20) x FAC_EXT_ACCESS(1.60) = 1.92x
modifier_stacking_validation.worst_case_effective_rate: 63 SF/hr brush/roll finish — slow but expected for overhead grooved ceiling from scaffold
